mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, date, recipe_id, request_id, recipe_business_id, meal_type_snapshot, protein_snapshot, carb_snapshot, fat_snapshot, calorie_snapshot FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_intake (user_id, date, recipe_id, request_id, recipe_business_id, meal_type_snapshot, protein_snapshot, carb_snapshot, fat_snapshot, calorie_snapshot) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{recipeDbId}, #{requestId}, #{recipeBusinessId}, #{mealTypeSnapshot}, #{proteinSnapshot}, #{carbSnapshot}, #{fatSnapshot}, #{calorieSnapshot}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_id = VALUES(request_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(calorie_snapshot), 0) FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date}

SELECT date, COALESCE(SUM(calorie_snapshot), 0) AS calories, COALESCE(SUM(protein_snapshot), 0) AS protein, COALESCE(SUM(carb_snapshot), 0) AS carb, COALESCE(SUM(fat_snapshot), 0) AS fat, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_intake WHERE id = #{intakeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date}
DELETE FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} AND recipe_id = #{recipeDbId}
DELETE FROM daily_intake WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} AND recipe_business_id = #{recipeId}
